top5.title: Could Jensen Huang lose his position at Nvidia?
top5.description: Jensen Huang has made Nvidia indispensable to the rise of AI. After an affair was revealed and the board of directors launched an investigation, Donald Trump and tech executives are questioning his future at the helm of the company.
top5.why: A potential leadership crisis at Nvidia could affect the company at the center of the AI infrastructure boom and unsettle markets.

top5.title: OpenAI reportedly raising $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
top5.description: OpenAI has reportedly secured $11 billion in a funding round that could reach $20 billion, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. The deal, smaller than expected, comes amid increased scrutiny of infrastructure spending and AI profitability.
top5.why: OpenAI’s reported $11 billion financing at a $1.25 trillion valuation would reset expectations for AI-company funding, valuation and profitability.

top5.title: Google invests $17 billion in a data center campus
top5.description: Google announced a $17 billion investment in its first data center in Wyoming, on a campus previously developed by Crusoe. The project will use natural-gas fuel cells, carbon capture and air cooling.
top5.why: Google’s planned $17 billion Wyoming data-center campus underscores the scale of AI infrastructure investment and the growing importance of alternative power and cooling systems.

top5.title: Apple wants to turn Siri into a more autonomous assistant
top5.description: Apple is working to make Siri an assistant capable of pursuing goals, deciding on next steps and independently carrying out certain tasks. The change could arrive as early as next year, according to Bloomberg.
top5.why: A more autonomous Siri could materially reshape Apple’s AI strategy and determine whether it can catch up in consumer-facing AI assistants.

top5.title: Companies remain responsible for their AI agents’ mistakes
top5.description: Four UK regulators have warned that organizations remain responsible for the autonomous AI agents they deploy.
top5.why: UK regulators’ warning that companies remain liable for autonomous agents’ mistakes establishes a key accountability principle for enterprise AI deployment.
